main_body: Stack of three cheese wheels: two wheels side by side at the bottom (rows 9-14) and a smaller wheel on top (rows 3-8), all yellow
top_band: At x=8 the top wheel has light yellow #f4dd85 on rows 4-5, plus a row-3 edge, about 3 rows. The lower wheels have only a 1-2 row light band (row 10 at x=8, rows 9-10 at x=12) before the front face. No elliptical top is drawn.
evidence: The main body is the lower pair of wheels, and its top is only 1-2 rows of light yellow above a flat 3-row front face (rows 11-13). That is a rim or thin band, not an ellipse of 4 or more rows, which the guide marks as a red thin-lid barrel. The upper wheel shows about 3 rows of top, but it is a small part and sits only 20 L above its front face. The wheels read as flat rounded rectangles seen from the front, with no front-edge line, eave shadow or ellipse top.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours and a median of 4 colours per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. Its ramp is shallow: a light highlight, a mid yellow and a dark brown #7c5a10 line. The outline is a tinted brown, so it is not near-black. The measured flat-fill coverage is 0%, but the 3-row bands of one yellow are plain fills with no rind texture, no per-wheel shading and no wedge or grain detail. That is far below the stall-cheese reference.
